faq.1.a: It stands for Structurally Enhanced Evaporative Cooling, the same physics that cools your skin when sweat evaporates, built into a deployable system for farm and vendor use.
faq.2.q: How does the ColdEasy Box work without electricity?
faq.2.a: The wet SEEC pad draws in warm, dry air. Water evaporates and absorbs heat, dropping the temperature inside, with no compressor, refrigerant or electricity.
faq.3.q: Can I store meat, fish or dairy?
faq.3.a: No. It works best for fruits, vegetables and flowers.

about.headline: Built for the people who grow India's food.
about.intro: Fresh produce begins losing vitality the instant it is harvested from the soil. In our hot climate, lack of accessible cooling at farm collection centres and roadside markets forces farmers into quick distress selling. ColdEasy was founded to deliver natural, electricity-free cooling hardware directly into grower and vendor hands.
about.vision: A future where people in low-resource environments can achieve higher incomes and better quality of life through affordable and sustainable cooling solutions.
about.mission: To build innovative, energy-efficient cooling and cold storage solutions that enable farmers, street vendors, and communities to reduce post-harvest losses, increase productivity, and exercise greater agency.
about.team_sub: Engineers, product designers, and technicians united by clean cold tech.
impact.headline: Cooling for a Resilient Future
impact.sub: Affordable cooling that helps people protect produce, strengthen incomes and build resilience.
impact.desc: Decentralized evaporative cooling placed at farm gates, aggregation sheds, and roadside stalls eliminates post-harvest deterioration where infrastructure is weakest.
impact.loss_1: When ambient heat wilts and softens harvested vegetables within hours, smallholder growers and micro-vendors face an immediate penalty: forced price markdowns or total discard.
impact.loss_2: Without electricity-free cooling options at harvest points, farmers cannot wait for fair pricing, and street vendors absorb losses daily from shrinkage. Decentralizing cooling directly at the point of sale converts potential waste into reliable, protected household earnings.
impact.photo_sub: Vegetable retailer market stall with ColdEasy Box crate
impact.photo_caption: Empowering smallholder retailers to retain harvest freshness throughout the day.
science.sub: How science keeps your produce fresher for longer.
science.body: Fresh fruits and vegetables are living organisms that respire, losing moisture and marketability rapidly after harvest. Without electricity or chemical refrigerants, ColdEasy arrests decay through natural thermodynamic airflow.
science.intro_1: Harvested food spoils when it is not kept cool and in the right condition.
science.intro_2: We believe this post-harvest loss is one of the most solvable crises because it is caused by the absence of infrastructure. Solving it must be a priority, as it sits directly at the intersection of livelihoods, nutrition security, and environmental sustainability. It is entirely solvable with the infrastructure designed specifically for the needs of farmers, vendors, and retailers.

sci.lose_title: What happens when produce loses the right environment?
sci.lose_sub: Two distinct environmental breakdown pathways trigger rapid post-harvest collapse.
sci.hot_body: Triggers accelerated respiration rates, rapid sugar breakdown, accelerated ripening, and swift cellular deterioration within hours of harvest.
sci.dry_body: Draws moisture out of crop skin and foliage, causing immediate weight loss, physical shrinkage, surface wrinkling, and wilting.
sci.farm_body: Forced into immediate distress selling at farm gates or wholesale mandis. Inability to hold produce past mid-day leads to heavy volume discards and depressed seasonal earnings.
sci.vendor_body: Produce wilts and shrinks under open sunlight. Vendors must discount prices drastically by evening or dump unsellable inventory, eroding thin daily profit margins.
sci.need: THE NEED FOR BETTER POST-HARVEST INFRASTRUCTURE
sci.ask: So, How Can We Create a Better Post-Harvest Environment?
sci.box_p1: ColdEasy Box uses passive cooling technology to create a controlled storage environment for fresh produce. The system uses water evaporation and airflow to maintain lower storage temperatures and improved humidity levels. This helps slow down the deterioration of fruits and vegetables while preserving their freshness.
sci.box_p2: By deploying SEEC (Structurally Enhanced Evaporative Cooling) technology, the system operates without conventional refrigeration compressors or electricity, providing an accessible cold chain solution directly at farm gates and local markets.
sci.box_diagram_alt: Exploded ColdEasy Box: ventilated top lid and perforated frame, SEEC honeycomb evaporative core, perforated structural housing, and reservoir base tray.
sci.seec_sub: Structurally Enhanced Evaporative Cooling engineered for rural farm and retail conditions.
sci.what_body: Structurally Enhanced Evaporative Cooling (SEEC) is a proprietary passive cooling approach that relies on natural thermodynamic phase change to absorb latent heat without chemical refrigerants or electricity.
sci.how_body: The water tank sits at the base of the crate. Two high-surface SEEC pads stand vertically in the reservoir and continuously absorb water upward through capillary wicking. Warm, dry outside air enters through side louvers, water evaporates and absorbs heat molecules, and cool humid air blankets the produce chamber before leaving through natural roof relief vents.
sci.achieve_body: Evaporation is used to slow moisture loss. Measured results are not published on this page.
sci.best_body: Designed specifically for fresh fruits, vegetables, and cut flowers. Not designed for meat, fish, or dairy products which require sub-zero frozen temperatures.
sci.cycle_sub: Water tank at the BASE; two SEEC pads stand in it and absorb water upward; warm dry air enters through pads, cools by evaporation, flows over produce chamber, leaves through roof vents with ethylene; zero fan.

policy.terms.title: TERMS & CONDITIONS
policy.terms.sub: Standard commercial and operational terms governing equipment sales and user interactions.
policy.terms.1.p: By accessing the ColdEasy web platform or placing an order for evaporative cooling crates, you confirm that you are at least 18 years of age and competent to enter into binding legal agreements under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. These services are intended for agricultural producers, street vendors, retailers, and FPO cooperatives operating in India.
policy.terms.2.p1: All prices listed on the platform are in Indian Rupees (INR) and are inclusive of applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST) unless explicitly itemized otherwise. ColdEasy reserves the right to revise catalog pricing, batch availability, or regional dispatch schedules.
policy.terms.2.p2: Order confirmation occurs upon digital payment receipt or confirmed offline FPO booking agreement.
policy.terms.3.p: Payments processed online are routed through RBI-authorized payment aggregators (e.g., Razorpay). ColdEasy does not store your debit card, credit card, or netbanking PIN credentials on internal servers. For large institutional consignments, RTGS/NEFT invoicing is facilitated directly by Temperate Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
policy.terms.4.p: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising in connection with equipment purchase shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Hyderabad, Telangana.
policy.terms.5.time: We acknowledge every complaint within 48 hours and resolve it within one month.
policy.privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
policy.privacy.sub: How ColdEasy handles customer contact numbers, delivery addresses, and WhatsApp permissions.
policy.privacy.1.p: We collect essential personal data needed to fulfill equipment delivery and coordinate rural logistics: full name, Indian mobile number (+91), shipping address, pin code, and optional GSTIN for business tax invoices.
policy.privacy.2.p: When you opt-in, we use WhatsApp to transmit dispatch updates, freight tracking details, and seasonal harvest maintenance guides. You may opt out of promotional broadcasts at any time by replying "STOP" on WhatsApp.
policy.privacy.3.p: We apply industry-standard encryption protocols. Data is retained for a period of 24 months to comply with statutory accounting and tax regulations in India. We do not sell or lease customer contact lists to third-party telemarketers.
policy.privacy.4.p: For queries or data deletion requests, email our data safety desk at privacy@coldeasy.in.
policy.privacy.4.officer: You can also write to our Grievance Officer, {name}, at {email}.

policy.refund.title: REFUND & CANCELLATION POLICY
policy.refund.sub: Inspection, return conditions, and replacement protocols for agricultural cooling hardware.
policy.refund.1.p: Orders may be cancelled free of charge prior to warehouse freight dispatch, typically within 24 hours of order confirmation. Once crates have been loaded onto interstate logistics carriers, standard return policies apply.
policy.refund.2.p: In the rare event of transit damage or manufacturing defects in the SEEC pad or crate housing, notify ColdEasy on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery with clear unboxing photographs. We will arrange a free reverse pickup and dispatch a replacement unit promptly.
policy.refund.3.p: Unused hardware in original packaging may be returned within a return window of 7 business days from delivery date, subject to verification by our technical inspection team.
policy.refund.4.p: Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method (or bank account via UPI/NEFT for offline purchases) within 5–7 working days.
policy.ship.title: SHIPPING & DELIVERY POLICY
policy.ship.sub: Logistics routes, freight handling, and expected arrival schedules across Indian agricultural regions.
policy.ship.1.p: Orders are typically packaged and dispatched within 1–2 business days. Delivery across tier-1 and tier-2 rural aggregation hubs generally arrives within 3–5 business days depending on weather and road transit access.
policy.ship.2.p: Standard orders above ₹5,000 qualify for complimentary door or mandi hub delivery. Orders below this threshold incur a nominal flat logistics charge of ₹250.
policy.ship.3.p: Certain remote pin codes (including selected mountain belts and island territories) may require special transport coordination. Our team works directly with regional transport unions to establish collection point delivery.
